shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do echo \"\\n--- "'$f ---"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,120p' && printf '\\n--- prerender manifest ---\\n' && cat .next/prerender-manifest.json"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git ls-files && printf '\\n--- shell html ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .next/server/app/index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- shell markers ---' && rg -o '

Dashboard

|Total Revenue|Total Invoices|Loading revenue\\.\\.\\.|Loading invoices\\.\\.\\.|class=\"loading\"' .next/server/app/index.html | sort | uniq -c && printf '%s\\n' '--- suspense markers ---' && rg -o '<"'!--'"\\"'$'"\\?-->' .next/server/app/index.html | wc -l && printf '%s\\n' '--- diff ---' && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx tsconfig.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\",
-    \"EVAL.ts\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\", \"EVAL.ts\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
printf '%s\\n' '--- final status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- changed files ---'
git diff --stat -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx
printf '%s\\n' '--- line references ---'
nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,150p'
nl -ba app/loading.tsx"
